Metadata.Goal: Enable production-safe completed-progress seal and forward-only conversation recovery for long mandatory-continuation turns.
Metadata.Description: Persist sealed conversation progress on unsettled timeout and resume from it without unsafe VM snapshots.

TaskSpace.name: runtime-progress-seal-recovery
TaskSpace.Description: Implement production-safe timeout progress sealing and recovery relay.

TaskGroup.name: Recovery scanner policy
TaskGroup.Description: Add explicit forward-only conversation head recovery semantics.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Scanner tests cover forward, backward, missing, and non-conversation mismatch.

Task.name: Add forward-only conversation recovery tests
Task.Description: Update recovery scanner coverage for the new head policy.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Backward or missing conversation mismatch remains dirty.

Task.name: Implement forward-only recovery policy
Task.Description: Change recovery classification with a narrow conversation-only forward policy.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Non-conversation authoritative head mismatch remains dirty.

TaskGroup.name: Production seal wiring
TaskGroup.Description: Bind the existing completed-progress seal callback in production runtime creation paths.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Production runtime coordinator receives a real seal callback.
Timeout path still does not save an unsafe VM snapshot.

Task.name: Wire seal callback in shell and terminal runtime
Task.Description: Pass `sealCompletedConversationProgress` to coordinator creation in production runtime paths.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Shell runtime bootstrap exposes a real `sealCompletedProgress` callback.
Terminal runtime passes a real `sealCompletedProgress` callback.

TaskGroup.name: Runtime integration verification
TaskGroup.Description: Prove settled-then-timeout recovery resumes from sealed conversation progress.
